goal: Solve a one-variable linear equation (ax + b = c).
steps: Move variable terms to one side (add/subtract the same value on both sides).
Move constants to the other side.
Divide both sides by the coefficient of x.
Check by substituting the solution back into the original equation.
Work through a concrete example step-by-step.
Explain the reasoning for each step in one sentence.
failure_modes: forgetting to apply an operation to both sides
confusing terms or definitions; re-derive from basics
